name: ROCKPUNK
tagline: Rock'n'roll guitar with two modelled strings and the Urban Slayer amp: 76 presets, no samples.
sub: Modelled rock guitar with amp, drive and delay
gumroad_title: ROCKPUNK GUITAR - Rock Guitar Instrument VST3 + AU Plugin (76 Presets) | Rock, Punk, Crunch, Leads
summary: A rock guitar instrument plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with two modelled strings per note, the Urban Slayer amp, four drive types, a tempo-syncable delay and 76 factory presets. No recordings: every note is calculated.
about: ROCKPUNK GUITAR, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, is a rock guitar you play from MIDI. Each note runs two modelled strings (a rhythm string A and a lead string B) that you blend with a layer mix, then goes through the Urban Slayer amp, a drive stage with four flavours (soft, hard, asymmetric and fuzz), a resonant filter, chorus, a tempo-syncable delay and reverb.

It ships no recording: every note is calculated, with up to 8 voices. An optional sampled layer plays your own .wav, .aif or .flac files if you drop them in a folder. The 76 factory presets are grouped in eight families: Crunch rhythm, Leads, High gain, Clean, Bare strings, Nocturnal, Textures and Low end.
Built for rock, punk, rock-flavoured Trap and Drill guitars, riffs, power chords and lead lines.

features.d: A rhythm string and a lead string, blended with a layer mix, each with tone, body, sustain and pick controls.
Gain, distortion, tone and level, with an asymmetric saturation stage.
Eight families: crunch rhythm, leads, high gain, clean, bare strings, nocturnal, textures and low end.
Free time or synced to the host tempo, with feedback and a low-pass in the loop.
Low-pass, band-pass or high-pass filter, a four-shape LFO, chorus and reverb.
Drop .wav, .aif or .flac files in a folder to play them on the keyboard. None are included.
Everything you make with it is yours.

includes: ROCKPUNK plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.
No. Every note is calculated by the two modelled strings. An optional layer plays your own audio files, and the factory presets do not need it.
Make sure at least one of the two speaker grills on the faceplate is lit: they switch the two strings on and off.

faq.q: Can I sell music made with it?
faq.a: Yes. The license is royalty-free with no credit required.
